cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(joyride C)

# The lifted game code is generated from the user's own executable by
# tools/lift.sh and never committed; the build needs it to exist.
set(JOYRIDE_GEN_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/gen/wino/recomp" CACHE PATH
    "Directory with the C generated by tools/lift.sh")
file(GLOB JOYRIDE_GEN_SOURCES "${JOYRIDE_GEN_DIR}/*.c")
if(NOT JOYRIDE_GEN_SOURCES)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "No generated code in ${JOYRIDE_GEN_DIR}. Run tools/lift.sh first.")
endif()

set(PCRECOMP "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/external/pcrecomp")
if(NOT EXISTS "${PCRECOMP}/runtime/win32hle/win32hle.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "pcrecomp submodule missing: git submodule update --init")
endif()

if(NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "joyride builds 64-bit: the guest's 4 GB is one mapping at a fixed host address")
endif()

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE RelWithDebInfo)
endif()

# SDL3 for the window, input, audio and SDL_GPU presenting; SDL3_ttf for the
# TrueType text win32hle's GDI draws.
find_package(SDL3 REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(SDL3_ttf REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)

# ffmpeg decodes the intro movie (Smacker). Optional: without it the game
# skips the movie.
option(JOYRIDE_WITH_FFMPEG "Play the intro movie through ffmpeg" ON)
if(JOYRIDE_WITH_FFMPEG)
    find_package(PkgConfig)
    if(PkgConfig_FOUND)
        pkg_check_modules(FFMPEG IMPORTED_TARGET libavformat libavcodec libavutil)
    endif()
    if(NOT FFMPEG_FOUND)
        message(WARNING "ffmpeg (libavformat, libavcodec, libavutil) not found: the intro movie will be skipped")
        set(JOYRIDE_WITH_FFMPEG OFF)
    endif()
endif()

# Guest memory: one 4 GB block at this host address; ADDR(va) adds it as a constant.
set(JOYRIDE_DEFS RECOMP_MEM_BASE=0x100000000000ull)

# --- the lifted game: huge, machine-made; build it fast and quietly ---------
add_library(joyride_gen OBJECT ${JOYRIDE_GEN_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(joyride_gen PRIVATE "${PCRECOMP}/runtime/recomp32" "${JOYRIDE_GEN_DIR}")
target_compile_definitions(joyride_gen PRIVATE ${JOYRIDE_DEFS})
target_compile_options(joyride_gen PRIVATE -O1 -w -include "${JOYRIDE_GEN_DIR}/recomp_funcs.h")

# --- pcrecomp's Win32 layer, minus its selftests and the four files that use
# SDL2: screen.c and present.c are replaced by joyride's SDL3/SDL_GPU screen,
# gdidc.c and dsound.c by SDL3 ports of themselves (src/platform/).
file(GLOB WIN32HLE_SOURCES "${PCRECOMP}/runtime/win32hle/*.c")
list(FILTER WIN32HLE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "(_selftest|/screen|/present|/gdidc|/dsound)\\.c$")
add_library(win32hle STATIC ${WIN32HLE_SOURCES}
    src/platform/screen_sdl3.c
    src/platform/gdidc_sdl3.c
    src/platform/dsound_sdl3.c)
target_include_directories(win32hle PRIVATE src/hle)
target_include_directories(win32hle PUBLIC "${PCRECOMP}/runtime/win32hle" "${PCRECOMP}/runtime/recomp32")
target_compile_definitions(win32hle PUBLIC ${JOYRIDE_DEFS})
target_compile_options(win32hle PRIVATE -w)
target_link_libraries(win32hle PUBLIC SDL3::SDL3 SDL3_ttf::SDL3_ttf Threads::Threads m)

# --- joyride itself ---------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(joyride
    src/host/main.c
    src/hle/mss.c
    src/hle/smack.c
    src/hle/ddraw_extra.c
    $<TARGET_OBJECTS:joyride_gen>)
target_include_directories(joyride PRIVATE src/hle)
target_compile_options(joyride PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-format-truncation)
target_link_libraries(joyride PRIVATE win32hle)
if(JOYRIDE_WITH_FFMPEG)
    target_compile_definitions(joyride PRIVATE JOYRIDE_WITH_FFMPEG)
    target_link_libraries(joyride PRIVATE PkgConfig::FFMPEG)
endif()
